claims.claim: Cummins says data-center backup-power demand continues to outpace expectations, creating a durable electrification/AI-infrastructure adjacency inside Power Systems.

risks.risk: Data-center power strength coexists with cyclical on-highway exposure and does not establish valuation attractiveness by itself.

unknowns.unknown: Issuer release does not isolate data-center revenue, backlog, customer concentration or incremental margin contribution.

claims.claim: Q2 2026 revenue reached a record $9.5B, up 9% year over year; Cummins raised full-year revenue growth guidance to 10%-13% and EBITDA margin guidance to 18.0%-18.5%, citing stronger demand including power generation.

risks.risk: Q2 EBITDA margin of 17.5% remained below the prior-year quarter's 18.4%, so revenue acceleration has not translated into year-over-year margin expansion in this quarter.

contradictions.contradiction: Record revenue and raised outlook coexist with lower year-over-year Q2 EBITDA margin.

unknowns.unknown: Durability of data-center demand and second-half truck recovery beyond current guidance remains unverified.
